items.title: Joe Harris Interview, 1961-04-12
items.q: Dave Bathardy made up his band... asked me that I wanted to play with him. I joined here... He was on a recreation... he had to leave the band

ctx.x: I'm trying to think. I thought if you could think of some of the old times he was playing with. Even if you think of some of the man was in Celestan's band.
Well, I did name, I think I named. I named everybody instead of Celestan's band. I think your name looked pretty well. I named everyone. Yeah. I even called Big Chief.
What did you not play a piano at the time?
